normalization_limits: Only plain ASCII children of exact intrinsic u.jsx nodes with literal className are ignored. Every other source byte remains bound; symbol remangling, runtime routing, dependency, HTML execution envelope or accounting changes require a new static review. No general JavaScript semantic equivalence is claimed.

v4_position_scope.pool_filter: NFT pool key, not a hardcoded pool ID

selection: six fixed stock tokens de-duplicated against both menus

credit.debt_basis: stored market totals with virtual shares 1000000 and virtual assets 1; rounded up; no elapsed interest accrual

turbo.selection: asset0,asset1,asset2 intersect supported V3 stock list

sportsbook.selection: housePot from potsOf at wsNET market value

valuation_conventions.v4_principal: Concentrated liquidity principal, tick bounds and pool sqrtPriceX96; sums principal legs only
valuation_conventions.v4_hohm: matching assetBondDesk-listed token oracle.priceWad; publisher may fall back to liveSqrtPriceX96 spot if call fails
valuation_conventions.v3_stock: Chainlink positive latest answer /1e8 times positive uiMultiplier /1e18, stock decimals18
valuation_conventions.wallet_stock: Chainlink positive latest answer /1e8, no uiMultiplier, stock decimals18
valuation_conventions.turbo_stock: Chainlink latest answer times uiMultiplier; pot/reserved/put/premium principal only
valuation_conventions.fees: V3,V4 and Turbo fees excluded from True RFV
valuation_conventions.credit_debt: stored Morpho market totals with virtual assets/shares, rounded up; not accrued to current timestamp

accounting_caveats: Current publisher source is observed over HTTP independently of the pinned RPC block and may change after retrieval.
Recognition is static source matching, not an independent Solidity audit or execution of the frontend.
No rendered/static numerical headline was available in the reviewed HTML; no website number is imported or compared.
Publisher catches some unavailable reads as zero or skips unsupported positions; the collector must retain stricter unavailable/unsupported handling rather than certifying partial totals.
Publisher uses JavaScript Number; RPC replica uses exact integer/rational arithmetic and can differ by rounding.
Current V4 publisher selection is registry token 3269350 only, not every discovered sleeve NFT.

Existing browser sessions, wallet-provider behavior and dynamically imported wallet/CCIP paths are not executed or certified by this source check; supported accounting trace uses ordinary read-only RPC results.
